newsitem.title: LEBANON: Beruit shares rally, Banque Audi hits high.
newsitem.headline: Beruit shares rally, Banque Audi hits high.

text.p: Banque Audi rose on the Beirut Stock Exchange to a new all time high of $23.125 on Friday, rising from a previous close of $23 and taking the total gains since its January flotation to over 50 percent.

Elswhere on the bourse demand exceeded supply for most active stocks. The BLOM general index rose 0.66 percent to 930.88 with turnover on the BSE topping 240,000 shares for a value of $1,858,718, up on the previous day's tally when shares worth a total of $1,541,829 changed hands.
One faller was BLC, which slipped to $17.625 from its recent record high $17.75 after a block of 5,000 BLC shares traded.
Another active stock was Bank of Beirut, which rose to $3.6875 from $3.625 after two blocks totalling 50,000 shares changed hands on the floor at $3.6875 and $3.625 respectively.
Solidere shares were also well sought with demand for its A shares reaching 280,808 against a supply of 63,067, lifting the price to $10.50 from $10.375.
Of the four industrial firms, pipemaker Eternit rose to $1.9375 from $1.875. Demand for the share was 72,500 against a supply of 10,500 -- 10,000 of which were executed.
